claimBoundary: Bounded shared runner for the documented integer single-choice profile, response structures and allowlisted scorers. The no-code and reviewed-import paths support 1-20 items on one shared integer scale with mean, sum and optional reverse scoring. A questionnaire needing a new scorer or mixed response scales requires code and review. The prototype does not establish permission, psychometric validity, equivalence, full WCAG conformance, general accessibility improvement or disability-group benefit.
